summary: Implemented Ledger.total: approved entries of the tenant, summed (refunds included), rounded to 2dp half away from zero.

criteria.test: total rounds half away from zero

criteria.criterion: Unapproved and other tenants' entries do not count
criteria.test: total ignores unapproved and other tenants

summary: Implemented Ledger.approve using FxIdentity.isActive and hasRole Approver, with check order SessionExpired, NotAuthorized, NotFound (tenant-scoped), SelfApproval, AlreadyApproved; sets Approved and ApprovedBy only.

criteria.criterion: Session idle exactly 15 min can approve; 15 min 1 s gets SessionExpired
criteria.test: approve works at exactly 15 minutes idle and expires after

criteria.criterion: Other-tenant entry is NotFound; self and already-approved errors in order
criteria.test: approve error order and tenant hiding

summary: Implemented Ledger.view: SessionExpired via isActive, otherwise only the session tenant's entries in original order; no role widens it.

criteria.criterion: Admin of t1 sees only t1 entries
criteria.test: view returns only own tenant for admin and expired gets error
view returns only own tenant for admin and expired gets error
